chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Saffar, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Safwan ibn Yahya, who said: Amr ibn Abi Nasr narrated to me.

He said: I said to Abi Abdillah عليه السلام: I urinate and perform wudu (ablution), but I forget my istinja', then I remember after I have prayed. He said: Wash your private part, repeat your salat (prayer), and do not repeat your wudu (ablution).
ai.seo_question: If someone forgets istinja' after urinating and remembers only after salat (prayer), must they repeat the wudu (ablution) and the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who performed wudu (ablution) after urinating but forgot istinja' and only remembered after offering salat (prayer). The Imam عليه السلام instructs that the person must wash the private part and repeat the salat (prayer), but does not need to repeat the wudu (ablution).
